findings.what: A finding label in the detail is still accepted in those disguised forms (check-format.py LABELLED, near line 160). Every form C5 lists is refused.

findings.recommendation: If a later issue changes role prompts, also assert the prompt line itself in tests/test_role_definitions.py; for now each prompt sends its role to its team file, which names the return.
findings.what: The third 2026-11-22 ruling asked that each layer's role prompts carry #198's return-format line; no prompt was changed and the test checks that the team files name the return instead. The outcome holds.

findings.recommendation: Check a column-1 block after a whitespace-only line, and a block after an unclosed fence, as requests.
findings.what: After a valid request, a column-1 block that follows a line holding only spaces is not checked, and nor is a block after an unclosed fence (the `~~~` part of this finding was fixed in e610fdc).

findings.recommendation: Add one case: a ``` fence holding a `~~~` line, then an empty line and a `-old` line.
findings.what: No test covers the rule that a fence closes only on the marker that opened it (`if marker == fence:` in check-format.py); changing it to `if marker is not None:` leaves both new tests passing. The code is correct today.

findings.recommendation: Refuse recommendations that say nothing (`n/a`, `-`, `TBD`) and read `none` after stripping zero-width and no-break spaces, in the text and dict forms.
findings.what: `n/a`, `-`, `TBD`, and `none` behind a zero-width or no-break space pass in all three formats; recommendation_ok (check-format.py lines 165-170) reads only ASCII letters at the start. In the dict form, " none" or "\tnone" also passes check_finding.

findings.recommendation: Refuse a lone CR and U+2028 in free-text values in every form, and treat trailing spaces the same in the text and dict forms.
findings.what: A lone CR inside a free-text value of a return passes because lines_of splits only on LF; check_finding refuses a CR but accepts U+2028. The text form strips trailing spaces (line 298); the dict form refuses "L ".
